headline: Executive order updates the Manual for Courts-Martial, the rulebook for military criminal trials, with 2010 amendments.
what_it_does: This order makes changes to the Manual for Courts-Martial, which sets the rules for how the military investigates, tries, and punishes crimes under the Uniform Code of Military Justice. The title says these are the 2010 amendments, but no summary was provided, so the specific changes are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the US armed forces
who_it_affects.how: They are subject to the military justice rules that this order changes.

who_it_affects.group: Military judges, prosecutors, and defense lawyers
who_it_affects.how: They must follow the updated rules when handling courts-martial.
